📘 Docu Reader – PDF Reader & Document Viewer for Android
Docu Reader is a fast PDF reader designed to help you view, read, and manage PDF documents and office files on Android with ease. Open your files instantly and enjoy a smooth, clutter-free reading experience anytime you need.
More than a basic PDF viewer, Docu Reader also works as a simple image to PDF converter and all-in-one document reader, making it easy for students, professionals, and everyday document tasks.
🔍 Read & View PDFs and Office Documents
Quickly open and read multiple document formats.
  Smooth PDF reader with fast loading
 
  Clear PDF viewer for ebooks, reports, and notes
 
  Read Word, Excel, PPT files
 
Use Docu Reader as your daily document viewer and file reader.
🔄 Image to PDF Converter – Simple & Smart

  Convert image to PDF with high quality output
 
  Create PDFs from photos, screenshots, or scanned pages
 
  Easy photo to PDF solution for notes, receipts, and forms
 
✂️ Manage PDF Files Easily

Handle essential PDF tasks with built-in tools.

  Merge PDF files into one document
 
  Split PDF pages or extract specific content
 
  Keep documents organized with smart file management
 
  Manage both personal and PDF business documents
 
 Everything works smoothly inside one compact PDF app.

📁 One App for Work, Study & Daily Use
Whether you're reading ebooks, reviewing work files, or organizing study materials, Docu Reader helps you stay productive.
 
✅ Why Choose Docu Reader?
  Fast & free PDF reader
 
  Simple image to PDF converter
 
  Supports multiple document formats
 
  Lightweight and easy to use
 
Stop switching between apps. Download Docu Reader today and enjoy a smooth, efficient PDF reader, PDF viewer, and document app — all in one place.
